content: Ani an Jesúsʼba-nanaimalad-e-idued, omegwa-Bab-Dummad-na-susadse, degi, e-mimmiganse an garda narmaksiid. Ar an amar napiragwadgi sabed. Unnila anbi an amar-sabsulid, bela dulemar-igar-napiragwad-wisgunonimalad amar-sabmarmogad.
Anmargi igar-napiragwad-naid-ular, an be-sabmalad, degi, we-igar-napiragwad anmarba degisadeguoed.
Bab-Dummad, degi, Jesucristo Bab-Dummad-Machi, napiragwadgi, degi, sabedgi, bemargi nued binsasun, wile-bemar-daksun, degi, ulubgi bogidikid bemarga ukbarsun.
Gwen-gwen be-mimmigan, Bab-Dummad-anmarga-igar-uksadba, igar-napiragwadgi nue-inniki-nanadii an dakargu, an nue-weligwar itosad.
Emigindi, omegwa, an bese wilesunnad, anmar na muchub-muchub gwenadgan-sabgumarsunye. An weyob bese garda narmakedi, wedi igar-binidsulid, ar gusgu bato negasailaun-akale, we-igar anmarga uklesad.
Bab-Dummad-Igar-islidikid-maidba-nanaedgi, sabgued oyoleged. Ar bemar negasailaun-akale, we-igar-islidikid-maid-bega-sognaid bato itodimalad, na be sabgudii nanamarye.
Ar bukidar dule-yardakmalad we-napneggi ainis gudimalad. We-dulemar sogmalad, Jesucristo we-napnegse dulemaryob gwalulessurye. Ar dule-deyob-sogedi, Cristoʼgi-yolegedid, dule-yardakedid.
Bemar nue-salakarmar, bemar-arbasadgi-ibmar-nikusad oyoggudamalar. Ar bur bule belagwapa ibmar-abingaed be imakmar.

Ar dule-wargwen Cristo-Igar-Maidgi-bangudele, Cristo-Igar-odurdaksadgi alamaknai gusulile, we-dule, Bab-Dummadba naisulid. Ar dule Cristo-Igar-odurdaksadgi alamaknairdi, we-dule, Bab-Dummadba naido, degi, Bab-Dummad-Machiba naibardo.
Ar dule-wargwen be-negse danikile, degi, we-Igar-Maidyob be-odurdakdanisulile, mer be abingao, degi, mer ega be sogbalo, wese-be-nonikid, nuedye.
Ar be a-dulega sogele, wese-be-nonikid, nuedye, a-dule-ibmar-isgana-imakedba, ibmar-isgana-imaknaiyob be gumogoed.

Amba an ibmar-bukidar bemarga narmaked nikanad, degi-inigwele, an yapa gardagindi bemarga an soged. Ar an bemarse ataknadapo an insado, agi, an-sunnad an bemarga ibmar-sogmaloed. Deyobi, anmar weligwar itomaloed.
Emi, be-gwenad-Bab-Dummad-na-susad-e-mimmigan, bega sogsimalad, bemarde nued sogeye. Be itomargua.
